title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Toyota 2000GT
description:
Most people know the Toyota 2000GT as the Japanese car from a James Bond film. Far fewer know how it started, or what it cost the company that built it. Here are two things you probably did not know about the Toyota 2000GT, and along the way, every place where our sources disagree with each other. Our sources are Wikipedia's pages on the Toyota 2000GT, the Nissan S30 and the Nissan Z-car, Classic and Sports Car on the twenty twenty-two Gooding sale, Hagerty, Sports Car Market, Shannons Club and Luxury Entertainment Partners. Where they conflict, we show both versions. Our own arithmetic is always labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
